q1_issues.issue: a bare generic with no quantifier word takes strength 0.9 (~most), so (Inheritance stored_mire_essence good) (STV 1.0 0.9) over-claims — 1.0 is reserved for "all"/"every".

the reified state's Experiencer is filled by a kind symbol (stored_mire_essence); a generic over a kind is either the flat Inheritance atom or a distributing rule with per-instance Skolem states, and no licensed form asserts one individual state witness whose holder is the kind itself.
the asserted state bundle (state, Experiencer, Still, duration) carries individual-fact truth values (STV 1.0 0.99) although the claim it encodes is an empirical generic, which the dial puts at 0.9.

q2_gaps: a duration on a kind-level generic property ("stays good for six months"): (Measure e duration <n> <unit>) attaches to an eventuality, but a copular generic over a kind reifies none and the flat Inheritance atom has no duration/shelf-life slot

a restrictive participial/adjectival modifier on a bare-kind (mass) generic subject ("stored mire-essence"): the copular generic's flat Inheritance has no slot for the restriction, and the instruction set routes restricted kind subjects into a distributing rule only for the relational/verbal case, so nothing decides between fusing the modifier into the kind symbol and a rule
notes: The Still tag for "stays" and the duration Measure shape are the right pieces; what is missing is a licensed eventuality at kind level for them to attach to. The genus atom (Inheritance stored_mire_essence mire_essence) also points at another compound rather than the single-word head noun essence that the compound-kind rule specifies.
